title: Aviation Data Source Staleness Watch
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flight:export source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures source-sync lag by data source for aviation telemetry feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside aviation telemetry feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `source-sync lag` on `flight:export` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst source-sync lag.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how long things take for each data source so you can see where aviation telemetry feeds slows down.
